scientific_integrity: Reproducible Gauss-sum proof and direct field enumerator. The claimed contribution is image-set additive energy, not the pre-existing individual root-count statistics.
scientific_limitations: Odd characteristic only; no complete higher additive moments; 2004 historical article inaccessible in full. Finite-field examples do not prove the universal claim. No independent mathematical audit.
title: Exact additive energy of a quadratic finite-field norm-perturbation value set
